# We're Hiring: Supervisor / Manager – Inland Freight Division · 2026-08-08T00:00:00+00:00

We're Hiring: Supervisor / Manager – Inland Freight Division

Interport Logistics, part of ALLYO Global Logistics, is expanding our transportation operations and is seeking an experienced Supervisor / Manager to lead our Inland Freight Division in the United States.

This leadership role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and building high-performing transportation teams.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop the Inland Freight team
Drive operational efficiency and service excellence
Build and strengthen relationships with carriers and customers
Oversee transportation operations, including LTL, FTL, drayage, and intermodal services
Ensure compliance, safety, and continuous process improvement
What We're Looking For

✔ Experience managing inland transportation or trucking operations
✔ Strong leadership and communication skills
✔ Customer-focused and results-driven mindset
✔ Experience with carrier management and freight operations
✔ Ability to lead in a fast-paced logistics environment

What We Offer
Competitive compensation and benefits
Career growth opportunities
Dynamic and collaborative culture
The opportunity to be part of a growing global logistics organization

If you're ready to lead a team that keeps supply chains moving, we'd love to hear from you.

📧 Apply today by sending your resume to:
careers@interport.us

Join our team. Move your career forward. Move the world.
